game.title: DiRT 5
game.blurb: Off-road arcade racing game from Codemasters, released 2020-11-05. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Racing, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Career
chapters.summary: The Career mode: its chapters, every type of Career Event, Gymkhana scores, the Superstar Finale and reaching level 50. Hidden milestones sit here too. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Driving Feats and Earnings
chapters.summary: Drifts, long jumps, clean laps, miles driven and total prize money.

chapters.title: Playgrounds, Liveries and Player Cards
chapters.summary: Building, testing and rating Playground arenas, and saving your own livery and player card.

chapters.title: Energy Career
chapters.summary: The Energy career: its 75 Stamps, Bulldozer, the Sprint and Gate Crasher events named in the achievements, and the Porsche Taycan.

chapters.title: Uproar Career
chapters.summary: The Uproar career: its 75 Medals, its Main Events, a Smash Attack event and the Duke Coupe Off Road Mod.

chapters.title: Super Size Career
chapters.summary: The Super Size Career: its 81 Stamps, its Main Events, the Brazil Land Rush events, the Bentley Continental and a Gate Crasher event.

chapters.title: Wild Spirits Career
chapters.summary: The Wild Spirits Career: its 75 Stamps, its Main Events, the Morocco Stampede events, the Prodrive Hunter and a Smash Attack event.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has no page under "Dirt 5" or "DiRT 5". dirt.fandom.com answers the API but has no page under "Dirt 5" or "DiRT 5" (codemasters.fandom.com returned HTTP 404), so Fandom is marked unverified. The Steam schema calls the app "CP2" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1038250 "DIRT 5". 5 of 40 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the Career chapter as a placeholder. Four extra careers are named in achievement descriptions: "Energy", "Uproar", "Super Size Career" and "Wild Spirits Career"; whether they are paid add-ons or free updates was not checked. The achievements that name only an event or a car (for example "Beat Bulldozer", the Porsche Taycan, "Rising Tide" and "Surf n Turf", "Race Oddity", "The Buy-In") were put with the career they sit next to in the Steam list; these placements are guesses from list position and need checking. "International" (Win a Multi-Class race in career) was put in the main Career chapter. Most of the extra-career achievements show under 3% on Steam. RAWG's playtime of 2 hours looks low.
